items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: So between Tony and Mr. LaVar, they straightened out.

ctx.x: Yeah. I had two jobs. Oh, two different bands. I had to work at Grand Island and I had to work at the island. See? So between Tony and Mr. LaVar, they straightened out. You know, between them, that would work that way.
And you were collecting the leaders for both jobs? Yeah. Both jobs. Where did you play? Grand Island?
